resources.name: Quantum Espresso (open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; can be substituted by other PAW-based codes (e.g., GPAW, ABINIT) as long as the PBE functional and similar parameters are used.

resources.notes: Original paper used VASP (proprietary); task rescoped to open-source alternative.

access.notes: Norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials that reproduce the PBE functional.
Used to post-process charge densities from DFT runs.
